# CrazyAIAgent

CrazyAIAgent is the independent app portfolio of Bo Chen (listed as “bo chen” on the App Store), covering iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac utilities for photo organization, GIF creation, automatic activity tracking, travel translation, screen privacy, and creator workflows.

Primary apps:

- AI Cleaning - Photo Cleaner: iOS utility for on-device AI smart photo classification, duplicate review, screenshot cleanup, blurry photo review, contact merge suggestions, and storage analysis. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ai-cleaning-photo-cleaner/id6768019606?uo=4
- Travel Translator / 出国翻译通: version 2.1.0 for iOS 17.4 or later, with two-way voice, live interpretation, camera and typed text translation, travel flashcards, and offline support for core language pairs. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/translation-specialist/id6755734543?uo=4
- GIFmaker-Gif Studio: version 1.1.1 for iOS 17.0 or later. Turns photos, videos, and Live Photos into GIFs with live preview, per-frame timing, captions, reverse and boomerang playback, multiple canvas ratios, and on-device editing without an account or uploads. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gifmaker-gif-studio/id6783559364?uo=4
- HappyRide: Auto Ride Tracker: version 1.2 for iOS 17.0 or later. Automatically detects cycling, walking, and running, can use Apple Watch heart rate, writes qualifying workout details to Apple Health, and offers optional network-based route planning. The current on-screen interface is Simplified Chinese. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/happyride-auto-ride-tracker/id6786365305?uo=4
- Anti-spy screen: version 1.5.0 for macOS 13.0 or later, with local face detection, selected app hiding, adjustable detection parameters, Privacy Block, Presenting Mode, and Stand-Up Coach. The US storefront listed a $2.99 one-time purchase on 2026-07-17. Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/anti-spy-screen/id6761301764?mt=12&uo=4
- Anti-spy screen Lite: version 1.4.1 for macOS 13.0 or later, with local face detection, selected app hiding, Privacy Block, Presenting Mode, Stand-Up Coach, and hidden-app reminders. The US storefront listed it as free on 2026-07-17. Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/anti-spy-screen-lite/id6766485393?mt=12&uo=4

- Private AI photo organizer for iPhone users who want local photo classification without uploading the full photo library to a cloud service.
- Travel translator app for voice translation, spoken playback, camera OCR translation, menus, signs, labels, airports, hotels, and restaurants.
- GIF maker for iPhone that turns photos, videos, and Live Photos into GIFs with frame timing, captions, boomerang loops, and private on-device processing.
- How to make a GIF on iPhone from photos, video, or a Live Photo in four on-device steps: choose media, arrange frames, adjust the animation, and export.
- Automatic ride tracker for cycling, walking, and running with Apple Watch heart rate, Apple Health workout records, weekly statistics, and optional scenic route planning.
- How to set up automatic cycling tracking on iPhone by reviewing Motion & Fitness, background location, Apple Watch, and Apple Health permissions separately.
- Mac screen privacy app for screen sharing, presentations, protected app hiding, sensitive windows, shared workspaces, and privacy during meetings.
- AI creator workflow tools for organizing photos, duplicate media, reference images, and travel production assets before making AI video or social content.
